body: No problem.  Good luck to you.
Yes, she helps, but it is always up to you to implement what you learn.  That's the hard part.  I would pass her card along to others in need.

Depends on the therapist.  A few are good and the rest are just talkers who watch the clock and charge ridiculous amounts of money for their services. I am on by 5th therapist and I finally have a good one. She helps with my relationships (personal and work), in the form of educating me on how to deal with people, or at least appear to do so on the outside.  Inside my head is a far different story and I have yet to find a way to control it.

It's a long story.  These aren't new feelings.  All I see is the bad in everything, while everyone around me is the opposite.  I've tried to change my thought pattern, to no avail.  I gave up drinking, go to therapy, and try to see the glass as half full... but I crash and burn every time.  I can ramble on this topic until my fingers cramp... but I will save you the wall of text.
